scope: Legacy GIS boundary and remote-sensing CSV failure reporting

behavior.gis_coordinates: Invalid CSV latitude/longitude values are not echoed to logs.
behavior.gis_database_errors: Direct boundary-update and batch failures log only exception classes; batch audit messages use a fixed summary plus the class.
behavior.remote_sensing_csv: Invalid source identifiers and row-processing failures no longer expose raw input or exception text in warning/audit output; row rollback is retained.

coverage: sensitive invalid coordinates are absent from GIS warnings
GIS direct-update failure logs only the exception class
GIS row exception is redacted from logs and audit
invalid remote-sensing source is not echoed
remote-sensing row exception is redacted from logs and audit with rollback and cleanup preserved

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; temporary CSVs and mocked connections

limitations: No live GIS database, remote-sensing provider, or ClickHouse service was contacted.
This does not establish populated-data lineage or live provider parity.
